criteria.evidence: The clean local reset applied all ten migrations through 20260806110000_pr004b_atomic_photo_replacement.sql, and both pgTAP files passed all 92 database tests.

pgTAP proves the intended database rules for viewer, active-admin, inactive-admin, non-admin, anonymous, and two-admin shared management, but the integrated service-role API path fails with PostgreSQL 42501 permission denied for schema private. Local email login is also disabled by the existing Supabase configuration, so authenticated browser/RLS login proof cannot complete.

The PostgreSQL implementation passed its direct pgTAP lifecycle checks, but the real service-role call to public.publish_content_revision failed with 42501 permission denied for schema private. Therefore draft save through first publish, later edit, republish, unpublish, and viewer selection did not pass as one integrated application path.

Authorized Chapters index headers and logout-immediate-Back protection passed on desktop Chromium and mobile Chrome, and unauthenticated/forged-cookie checks passed on desktop. Published-detail proof was skipped because no legitimate active revision can be created through the blocked service-role publication path after the clean reset.

The 37 photograph-replacement pgTAP assertions passed, including exact sort order, caption and placement preservation, draft cover transfer semantics, both active admins, unchanged published cover and revision-media snapshots, and no leak before republish.
pgTAP passed the PR004B_LETTER_PUBLICATION_FORBIDDEN database check, and the full unit suite passed the creation-choice and disabled-publication UI assertions.
The guarded local integration cleanup reported users=0, content=0, media=0, associations=0, objects=0, throttle=0 after the failed full run and again before and after the final focused residue check.

The production dependency audit reported 0 vulnerabilities; type-check and lint passed; the standard full suite passed 350 tests with 47 expected non-live skips; the unchanged production build passed on retry after one Windows native worker exit; and git diff --check passed.

The installed scope gate validated the contract, captured the baseline, and reported only the new local-only Vitest configuration in the task delta. This result is recorded as failed and is used to close both decision ledgers without release action.
